text:
maria: Quick ask: can someone run a small bench to measure KV prefetch impact on paged-attn fusion? I'm seeing a small stutter on long sequences in the canary run, want to confirm it's the prefetch codepath. seq~12k, batch 1-2.

hugo: I can take it. Which model and hardware? also do you want quantized runs?

maria: Model: redwood/large-open-8k (the one we use in nightly). Hardware: A100-80GB if possible (perf pool). Please test both prefetch=on and prefetch=off, and the paged-fusion variant vs no-fusion. Run ~100 iters each.

oliver: I can reserve a slot on perf pool. @hugo do you need exclusive GPU? or can it be shared with other perf runs?

hugo: Shared is fine, but set --cpu-affinity low and --warmup 20 to reduce noise.

maria: Example command to use:
```
python -m perf.run_bench --model redwood/large-open-8k \
  --seq 12288 --batch 1 --iters 100 \
  --fusion paged-fused --kv-prefetch true --warmup 20
```
Change --kv-prefetch to false for baseline.

ci-bot: perf-queue: reserved 'perf-small' slot on a100-80gb for hugo @ 2024-12-03T10:30:00Z :white_check_mark:

hugo: Ran both configs. Quick numbers (median throughput tokens/s, p99 latency ms):
```
prefetch=false, fusion=paged-fused -> med: 52k tps, p99: 45ms
prefetch=true,  fusion=paged-fused -> med: 48k tps, p99: 58ms
prefetch=true,  fusion=none       -> med: 50k tps, p99: 50ms
```
Looks like enabling prefetch with paged-fused increased p99 significantly.

rachel: Interesting — could be KV eviction thrashing when prefetch brings extra pages into memory. Can you grab an nvprof / NVTX trace and also the KV cache hit/miss counters (set KV_PREFETCH_STATS=1)?

hugo: Will re-run with KV_PREFETCH_STATS=1 and --nvtx. Uploading trace to GDrive: https://gdrive.fake/redwood/perf/hugo/2234507890 (perm: team)

maria: Thanks. If trace confirms eviction spikes, plan is: 1) add a microbench test for prefetch+paged-fusion combo, 2) try tuning prefetch window (smaller) and 3) open a PR with a fallback to disable prefetch when paged-fusion is active. I'll draft the perf test and PR template.

oliver: tagging @eng-sre to monitor perf-queue impact in case we need more slots.

ci-bot: note: perf regression alert will trigger if master P99 increases >10% over baseline for this nightly benchmark.

maria: OK — thanks everyone. Assigning follow-ups: hugo -> run traces and upload; rachel -> look at traces and suggest tuning; oliver -> manage perf slot scheduling. Will sync async, ping me if you hit infra limits. :thumbsup:

hugo: On it, starting traces now.
